description: This file implements the KernelLogEventsHandler class, which manages kernel log event monitoring, including reading events from a file descriptor, processing specific event types, and notifying subscribers.

classes.name: KernelLogEventsHandler
classes.description: Handles kernel log events, manages subscribers, and processes kernel log events in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: KernelLogEventsHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a kernel log file descriptor and starts the read thread.

methods.name: ~KernelLogEventsHandler
methods.description: Destructor that stops the read thread and cleans up resources.

methods.name: ReadLoop
methods.description: Main loop that waits for kernel log events and processes them accordingly.

methods.name: AddSubscriber
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber callback to receive events and immediately delivers the last known events.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscriber based on its ID.

methods.name: DeliverEvent
methods.description: Delivers an event to all subscribers and updates the last events list.
